factual_objections.claim: The Stockholm talk occurred in April 2026.
factual_objections.evidence: The packet supplies a May 13, 2026 publication date but does not establish the event date. Publication in May neither confirms nor contradicts an April event.
factual_objections.label: unverified

factual_objections.claim: Graham says family and life matter more than the company.
factual_objections.evidence: The supplied evidence does not establish this attributed statement.
factual_objections.label: unverified

factual_objections.claim: The statistic has no published method, and Altman is less sure the Bay Area premium will persist over the next decade.
factual_objections.evidence: The packet establishes the statistic and Graham's qualifications, but provides neither evidence about whether a method was published nor Altman's position.
factual_objections.label: unverified

factual_objections.claim: Remote work and other hubs have weakened the geographic argument.
factual_objections.evidence: The packet does not establish that effect. Graham explicitly says his recommendation remains the same; that establishes his position, without settling whether geographic advantages have objectively weakened.
factual_objections.label: unverified

verdict.reason: A captures Graham's explicit recommendation to go temporarily, the benefits of returning to Stockholm, and the qualified unicorn statistic. B offers reasonable practical advice but understates his current affirmative position and omits the Stockholm-specific return benefit and statistical caveat.
